b_tangent.class_K: structural: psi_+ = 2Z/(2r+1), Z = 2r/(2r+1) G_N - (1-xi^2)^4((1-xi^2)H_xi/8 - xi H) + zeta0 + kappa + (1-xi^2)^4 H_e(xi,c); (1-xi^2)^4 = 512 r/(1+(2r)^(1/4))^8, so every non-constant piece is r times a smooth function of ((2r)^(1/4), cos theta): continuous at 0 with value 2 (zeta0 + kappa), |grad| = O(1), |Lap| = O(1/r), decays like 1/r at infinity (K1-K3 hold).
